display_long_description:
Medic Simulator: Combat Zone is a VR combat medic simulator where you save wounded soldiers in an intense battlefield war zone. Experience realistic military medical gameplay, rescue missions, and action under enemy fire.

• Stabilize wounded soldiers using real combat triage techniques
• Remove projectiles and foreign objects from battlefield injuries
[media]
• Perform emergency procedures at a forward aid station

• Stop severe bleeding and control hemorrhages
• Apply tourniquets and bandages to critical injuries
[media]
• Transport patients safely to the infirmary
[media]

• Administer aerosol medications and emergency treatments
[media]

• Rescue injured soldiers under enemy fire
[media]

• Search for the wounded with ambulances and medical teams

• Defend yourself and reload weapons during combat situations
[media]

• Complete intense VR rescue missions across the combat zone

If you enjoy VR war games, medical simulators, military rescue games, and action combat experiences, Medic Simulator: Combat Zone delivers a unique mix of combat and life-saving gameplay.

The battlefield is unforgiving — but the adrenaline is unmatched.
Are you ready to answer the call?
